name: Distance Correction Factor for Refracted Paths
aliases: Distance Correction Factor D for Refracted Paths
definition: A factor D used in the contribution formula for refracted light paths to account for geometric spreading and refraction effects, ensuring visually correct results matching reference solutions.
summary: The Distance Correction Factor for Refracted Paths scales light intensity by the solid angle subtended by the source, adjusted for refraction, ensuring visually correct radiance in participating media.
